# Bear Carpet Care

> Carpet, upholstery, and oriental rug cleaning company serving Harrisburg,
> Pennsylvania and the surrounding Central PA region. Over 30 years in business.
> Non-toxic, hypoallergenic, biodegradable cleaning solutions that are safe for
> children and pets. Free, no-obligation quotes.

## Key facts

- **Business name:** Bear Carpet Care
- **Location:** Harrisburg, Pennsylvania, United States
- **Phone:** (717) 454-7347
- **Email:** bearcarpetcarepa@gmail.com
- **Website:** https://bearcarpetcare.com/
- **Service area:** Harrisburg, York, Lancaster, Lebanon, Hershey, and Central Pennsylvania
- **Experience:** Over 30 years
- **Hours (ET):** Mon–Fri 8am–7pm, Sat 10am–5pm, Sun 10am–3pm
- **Quotes:** Free, no obligation
- **Methods:** Non-toxic, hypoallergenic, biodegradable; safe for children, pets and allergy sufferers

## Services

- [Carpet cleaning](https://bearcarpetcare.com/carpet-cleaning.html): Deep steam
  cleaning of wall-to-wall carpet, stairs and hallways; spot and stain removal;
  pet odor removal using enzyme treatments; Scotchgard protection; sanitizing and
  deodorizing; pre-conditioning for heavily soiled areas. A typical room takes
  20–30 minutes, a whole home 2–4 hours, and carpets dry in 6–12 hours.
  Recommended every 12–18 months, or every 6–12 months with pets or children.
- [Upholstery cleaning](https://bearcarpetcare.com/upholstery-cleaning.html):
  Steam cleaning for sofas, sectionals, loveseats, chairs, armchairs, recliners,
  ottomans and dining chairs, in microfiber, cotton, linen, velvet and most
  blends. Optional Scotchgard protection. A single piece takes 30–60 minutes, a
  full living room set 2–3 hours, and fabric dries in 2–6 hours.
- [Oriental and area rug cleaning](https://bearcarpetcare.com/oriental-rug-cleaning.html):
  Cleaning, repair and restoration of Oriental, Persian, Turkish, Indian,
  Chinese, Karastan, braided, shag, machine-made and hand-woven rugs in wool,
  silk, cotton and synthetic fibers. Free pick-up and delivery. Repairs include
  reweaving, moth damage repair, fringe repair and replacement, renapping, colour
  retouching, machine serging, binding and size reduction. Typical turnaround is
  5–7 business days.
